How to renew my skin subscription?
Skin subscription will be automatically renewed on the last day of the current billing cycle, unless you turn off automatic renew in the app store.

values.name: englishlocalization
values.value:
Unsubscribe Instructions

Deleting Yalla Parchis from your phone will not cancel your skin subscription and you can follow these steps to cancel future payments.

Once you cancel the skin subscription, you can still use the skins you have paid for the remaining days. Previous completed payment will not be refunded or partly refunded based on cancellation date.

values.name: englishlocalization
values.value:
How to cancel skin subscription?
Cancellation steps
1) Open Google Play on an Android device.
2) Click 'Menu' and jump to 'Subscription'.
3) Select the subscription you want to cancel.
4) Click 'Unsubscribe'.

values.name: englishlocalization
values.value:
How to cancel skin subscription?

1) Open APP store on an iPhone.
2) Click your account and click 'Subscription'.
3) Select the subscription you want to cancel.
4) Click 'Unsubscribe'.

values.value:

You won't be charged again when restoring your in-app purchase.
Follow the instructions to enter the same Apple ID you used to make the purchase.
It takes time to restore the operation. Please check the privilege page later if it doesn't reset in time.

values.value:
1. You can get activation credits by finishing tasks or other actions in the chat room.
2. The activation credits can be exchanged for S.T points after the calculation and can be collected in the next day.
3. The S.T points will expire if they are not collected in the next day.
4. The calculation is based on the time zone GMT-5.
5. The total S.T points in the platform will not change, and will be daily distributed according to the portion of your activation credits.
6. You can collect the S.T points in the next day only when your activation credits meet the lowest standard of the day.

values.name: englishlocalization
values.value:
1.Lowest standard of activation credits: according to yesterday's total activation credits produced, the average per capita of today will be the lowest standard of the activation credits. If the average is too high, there will be more users who can exchange for the points. For example, if yesterday's total activation credits are 10k with the contribution of 10 users, the average and the lowest standard to be able to exchange for S.T points will be 1000. If only 2 users participate, the standard will be 500, which is the basic value. 
2.Exchange activation credits for S.T points: when reaching the lowest standard, the user will get the points distributed according to the portion contributed of the total activation credits. 
3.The quantity of S.T points distributed in one day is normally a fixed number, but if the number of users who reach the standard yesterday is more than two-thirds of the day before, one more user means 300 points additional to the quantity of points. 
For example, if the daily points distributed is 4M with 10k users who reach the standard on the first day, and on the second day the number of users is 9k, which means that there are 2,334 users more than two-thirds of 10k people. In this case, 700.2k points will be added and the total points distributed will be 4,700.2k. And if you contribute 10% of all the activation credits, on the third day you can get 470k points.
